subtitle: How a Maratha sea lord bent empires to his tide

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of a stone sea fort with monsoon clouds and ships beyond
panels.action: Sarkhel Kanhoji Angre stands on the bastion of a Konkan sea fort, cloak whipping in the sea wind, as dark sailing ships dot the restless Arabian Sea beyond rugged cliffs and surf.

dialogue.text: In the age of rising empires, Sarkhel Kanhoji Angre forged a Maratha navy and made the western seas bow to coastal power.

i18n.hi: उभरते साम्राज्यों के दौर में सरकार कान्होजी आंग्रे ने मराठा नौसेना गढ़ी और पश्चिमी सागर को तट की ताकत के आगे झुका दिया।

panels.shot: wide aerial establishing shot of the Konkan coastline and Arabian Sea
panels.action: A sweeping view of the Konkan coast shows jagged cliffs, dense green hills, stone sea forts on rocky islets, and late-17th-century ships plying the grey-blue Arabian Sea under a hazy sky.

dialogue.text: The Konkan coast was a long, broken blade of rock and forest, where surf hammered stone and monsoon winds ruled more harshly than any king.

i18n.hi: कोंकण का तट चट्टान और जंगल की टूटी तलवार था, जहाँ लहरें पत्थर पीटतीं और मानसून की हवाएँ हर राजा से सख्त राज करतीं।

panels.shot: medium shot from behind a younger Angre on a cliff overlooking the sea
panels.action: A younger Kanhoji Angre, in simple coastal warrior garb, stands barefoot on a cliff edge, looking down at fishing boats and a small armed vessel cutting through waves near a rough jetty.

dialogue.text: In this harsh strip between Sahyadri and sea, Kanhoji rose from the surf and stone of local war to become the Maratha hand upon the waters.

i18n.hi: सह्याद्री और समंदर के बीच इसी कठोर पट्टी में, कान्होजी लोकल जंग की लहरों और पत्थरों से उठकर पानी पर मराठा हाथ बन गया।

panels.shot: dynamic low-angle wide of a coastal skirmish at sea
panels.action: On choppy waters, Kanhoji Angre, slightly older, stands firm on the deck of a nimble Maratha vessel as it closes with a larger ship; sailors haul ropes and oars bite the water, with a rocky island fort in the distance.

dialogue.text: By the turn of the century, he commanded swift ghurabs and gallivats, light craft that darted between rocks where deep-draught European ships dared not follow.

i18n.hi: सदी बदलते ही उसके पास तेज घुराब और गॅलिवॅट थे – हल्के जहाज़ जो उन चट्टानों में फिसलते, जहाँ गहरे यूरोपी जहाज़ घुसने से डरते।

panels.shot: interior medium shot in a fort audience hall, side-lit, with coastal chiefs around
panels.action: In a stone hall lit by oil lamps, Kanhoji Angre sits alert among Maratha commanders and coastal elders, a map of the Konkan coast spread before them, with forts like Suvarnadurg and Vijaydurg marked.

dialogue.text: The Maratha state, born in the hills under Shivaji, now needed the sea. Coastal chiefs and officers like Angre became the shield between inland power and ocean empires.

i18n.hi: शिवाजी के पहाड़ों में जन्मी मराठा सत्ता को अब समंदर चाहिए था। आंग्रे जैसे तटी सरदार ढाल बने – घाटी की ताकत और समंदर के साम्राज्यों के बीच।

panels.shot: close-up on Kanhoji's thoughtful face over a map with European and Indian ports marked
panels.action: Kanhoji Angre studies a rough chart showing Bombay, Chaul, Suvarnadurg, and distant Goa, his fingers resting near the approaches to Maratha-held harbours and the routes of foreign company ships.

dialogue.text: To European companies, the sea was a highway of profit. To Kanhoji, it was a battleground where customs, treaties and tribute decided whether Maratha coasts would stand free or be choked.

i18n.hi: यूरोपी कंपनियों के लिए समंदर मुनाफे की सड़क था। कान्होजी के लिए ये रणभूमि थी, जहाँ महसूल, वचन और नजराना तय करते कि मराठा तट आज़ाद रहेगा या घुटेगा।

panels.shot: wide shot of Suvarnadurg sea fort rising from the waves with ships anchored nearby
panels.action: The massive stone walls of Suvarnadurg sea fort rise sheer from the water, bastions bristling with cannon; Maratha ships are moored nearby as waves crash against the rock base.

dialogue.text: From sea forts like Suvarnadurg and Vijaydurg, carved into rock and surf, Kanhoji turned the Konkan into a chain of watchful eyes and guns.

i18n.hi: सुवर्णदुर्ग, विजयदुर्ग जैसे समुद्री किलों से, जो लहरों और चट्टान में खुदे थे, कान्होजी ने कोंकण को चौकस आँखों और तोपों की ज़ंजीर बना दिया।

panels.shot: medium interior shot of Kanhoji with Maratha envoys, a scroll between them
panels.action: Inside a fort chamber, Kanhoji Angre receives Maratha envoys; a formal scroll bearing the Peshwa’s seal lies between them, as attendants and scribes look on respectfully.

dialogue.text: After hard bargaining and conflict, a settlement in 1713 bound coastal steel to inland pen, and Kanhoji was recognized as Sarkhel, admiral of Maratha sea power.

i18n.hi: कड़े सौदों और लड़ाइयों के बाद १७१३ के समझौते ने तटी तलवार को दरबारी कलम से जोड़ा, और कान्होजी को मराठा समुद्री ताकत का सरकार सर्खेल माना गया।

panels.shot: low-angle medium shot of Kanhoji on a bastion as a Maratha flag rises behind him
panels.action: Kanhoji Angre stands on a bastion as a Maratha saffron standard is hoisted in the wind; below, sailors and gunners at Suvarnadurg watch with a mix of pride and discipline.

dialogue.speaker: sarkhel_kanhoji_angre
dialogue.text: The sea lane past our coast is no one’s gift. It will be earned.

i18n.hi: हमारे तट के पास की समंदर-राह किसी की मेहरबानी नहीं। इसे कमाना पड़ेगा।

panels.shot: wide shot of a crowded harbour with European and Indian ships at anchor
panels.action: A bustling early-18th-century harbour shows European masts, Indian craft, warehouses, and busy quays, with merchant brokers and guards moving amid bales and crates.

dialogue.text: Portuguese viceroys in Goa, English factors in Bombay, and other companies all claimed the sea with parchment and cannon, yet still had to pass through waters watched by Maratha forts.

i18n.hi: गोवा के पुर्तगाली वायसराय, बंबई के अंग्रेज़ फैक्टर और बाकी कंपनियाँ कागज़ और तोप से समुद्र अपना बताते, पर फिर भी मराठा किलों की नजरों से होकर ही गुजरते।

panels.shot: medium shot of Kanhoji on deck intercepting a European vessel at sea
panels.action: On a rolling sea, a Maratha warship under Kanhoji closes alongside a European company vessel; Angre stands firm as his crew prepare to board and officers on the foreign deck look anxious and hesitant.

dialogue.text: He seized ships that refused Maratha dues or violated coastal claims, actions European captains branded as piracy and he defended as the rights of a coastal power.

i18n.hi: जो जहाज़ मराठा महसूल न देते या तटी हक तोड़ते, उन्हें वो पकड़ लेता – जिसे यूरोपी कप्तान लूट कहते, और वो तटी ताकत का अधिकार।

panels.shot: interior shot of a European council room in Bombay with anxious officials
panels.action: In a paneled council room in Bombay, British East India Company officials in wigs argue over maps, a model ship on the table, and reports scattered about, expressions tense and frustrated.

dialogue.text: Company records from Bombay call him a 'pirate', yet those same pages show something deeper: fear of a local admiral they could not easily crush or ignore.

i18n.hi: बंबई की कंपनी दफ्तरी उसे 'समंदर डाकू' लिखती है, पर उन्हीं पन्नों में असली बात झलकती है – एक देसी सर्खेल का डर, जिसे न आसान दबा सके, न अनदेखा।

panels.shot: wide bird’s-eye shot of a joint British-Portuguese fleet approaching a Maratha sea fort
panels.action: A combined line of British and Portuguese warships advances in formation toward a Maratha sea fort, their sails full and guns run out, while the rocky coastline looms treacherously close.

dialogue.text: In 1718 and again in 1720, European fleets sailed against his strongholds, combining British and Portuguese strength to break the chain of Maratha forts.

i18n.hi: १७१८ में और फिर १७२० में, ब्रिटिश–पुर्तगाली मिलीजुली यूरोपी फौजें उसके गढ़ों पर चढ़ीं, ताकि मराठा किलों की ये ज़ंजीर तोड़ दें।

panels.shot: tight medium shot of Kanhoji on the fort parapet during a bombardment, calm amid chaos
panels.action: Kanhoji Angre stands on the parapet of a battered fort as distant ships fire; smoke drifts over the walls and gunners behind him work their pieces, his face composed and watchful.

dialogue.speaker: sarkhel_kanhoji_angre
dialogue.text: They bring their ocean to our rocks. Let the rocks answer.

i18n.hi: ये अपना समुद्र हमारी चट्टानों तक लाए हैं। अब चट्टानें जवाब देंगी।

panels.shot: wide shot of failed European assault, ships veering away from the rugged fort and shoals
panels.action: European ships are shown turning away from the fort, some listing or entangled in shoals near jagged rocks, while the Maratha stronghold still stands above the surf.

dialogue.text: The assaults faltered against reefs, monsoon seas and stone bastions. Company diaries record frustration, losses, and retreat from the Konkan’s unyielding teeth.

i18n.hi: हमले रीफ, मानसूनी लहरों और पत्थर के बुर्ज से टकराकर टूटे। कंपनी की डायरियाँ बस झुँझलाहट, नुकसान और न मानने वाले कोंकण से वापसी लिख पाईं।

panels.shot: wide shot of another distant fleet in harsher seas, emphasizing repetition of failed campaigns
panels.action: Under darker, stormier skies, yet another European fleet struggles in heaving seas off the Konkan, their line ragged as waves crash and coastal hills loom through rain.

dialogue.text: Again in 1721 and 1722, new expeditions found the same hard truth: deep-keel ships and distant orders could not easily master these close, dangerous shores.

i18n.hi: १७२१ और १७२२ में निकली नई मोहिमों ने वही सख्त सच पाया – गहरी कील वाले जहाज़ और दूर के हुक्म इन टेढ़े, खतरनाक किनारों को आसानी से नहीं झुका सकते।

panels.shot: intimate medium shot in a fort courtyard where Kanhoji inspects shipwrights and sailors
panels.action: In a busy fort courtyard, Kanhoji Angre walks among shipwrights shaping timber, rope-makers twisting coir, and sailors training with oars, nodding as he observes their work.

dialogue.text: His strength lay not in myth alone, but in labour: shipwrights, rope-makers, pilots and fighters who turned scattered coastal people into a disciplined maritime arm.

i18n.hi: उसकी ताकत कहानी में नहीं, मेहनत में थी – मल्लाह, जहाज़-गढ़ने वाले, रस्सीबाज़, राह-जान और लड़ाके, जिन्होंने छिटके तटी लोगों को सधी हुई समुद्री फौज बना दिया।

panels.shot: evening wide shot of Kanhoji on a bastion overlooking a calm sea at dusk
panels.action: At dusk, an older Kanhoji Angre stands alone on a fort bastion, the sea calm and golden below, a few ships at anchor as the sky darkens and torches are lit along the walls.

dialogue.text: By the time his long command ended, Kanhoji had held the Konkan seas for decades, forcing even distant empires to treat with a coastal admiral they once dismissed.

i18n.hi: अपने लंबे हुक्म के आखिर तक कान्होजी ने दशकों कोंकण का समंदर थामे रखा, दूर के साम्राज्यों को भी मजबूर किया कि जिस तटी सर्खेल को कभी हँसी में टालते थे, उससे अब समझौता करें।

panels.shot: wide contemporary-evoking shot of multiple Konkan sea forts along the coast, timeless and silent
panels.action: A timeless view strings together silhouettes of Suvarnadurg, Vijaydurg, Sindhudurg and island forts like Khanderi along the Konkan, their stone walls etched against sea and sky, waves endlessly breaking below.

dialogue.text: Today these sea forts stand in stone and record as part of a wider Maratha military landscape, reminders that control of coasts can guard the freedom of the land behind them.

i18n.hi: आज ये समुद्री किले पत्थर और दस्तावेज़ों में मराठा सैन्य परिदृश्य का हिस्सा बने हैं – याद दिलाते हुए कि तट पर पकड़, पीछे की ज़मीन की आज़ादी की रखवाली कर सकती है।

title_i18n.en: Kanhoji Angre Rules the Western Seas
title_i18n.hi: कान्होजी आंग्रे – पश्चिम सागर का सम्राट

subtitle_i18n.en: How a Maratha sea lord bent empires to his tide
subtitle_i18n.hi: कैसे एक मराठा समुद्री सरदार ने साम्राज्यों की धार मोड़ दी
